'''Squad 815''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] that was deployed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The squad was sent by [[Darth Lachris]] to reinforce the Imperial forces combating [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[Cheketta]] in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].
